name: Expanded Ranger Spell List
body:
You expand your divine spellcasting.

Prerequisites: Ranger level 4, Caster level 1

Benefit: Add one druid spell per spell level to your ranger class spell list.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time it’s taken, you may select another spell.
